content=The audit report generation failed because the Word summary document did not include the required high-priority facility-session combinations.
While 5 tests passed, test_word_summary_content failed with 'AssertionError: Word summary must mention at least two high-priority facility-session combinations'. The verifier found 'assert 0 >= 2', indicating that top sessions like 'FAC-SESS' were missing from OUTPUT_DOCX. Ensure the Document(OUTPUT_DOCX) logic correctly populates the summary text with facility-session IDs derived from the audit results.
